comments.text: Finland being ranked the world's happiest country while having some of the longest, darkest winters is the ultimate paradox — and honestly the sauna culture explains half of it. Loved the contrast between the quiet cities and the Arctic wilderness. What's the one Finnish habit you think the rest of the world should steal?

comments.author: @UnrealWorldJourney1
comments.text: Finland is interesting because its happiness ranking seems to come less from constant excitement and more from stability, trust and access to nature. 🇫🇮🌲 Sauna, mökki life and the ability to disappear into a forest or beside a lake are not just tourist traditions, but part of how many Finns structure everyday life. That quieter definition of wellbeing is probably what outsiders often misunderstand.
